description: Signed connection strings (cashhub1, circlehub1, cashorder1): the signed text <label>:<chain>:<TLV 0>:<TLV 4>:<relay_hash>:<label_hash>, its digest under the chain's signed-message prefix, TLV 5, the exact strings; decoder refusals (missing, repeated or malformed TLV 0/2/4/5/6), unverified cases, a type above 6 outside the signature, uppercase strings decode and mixed case is refused; chain names and the online check against get_info.
source: nipcash/connsig.go, cashhub_connection.go, online.go, nipcw/circlehub_connection.go, nipCO/connection.go, internal/credcodec; nipcash/cashhub_connection_test.go, nipcw/circlehub_connection_test.go, nipCO/connection_test.go (K-CH-1..2, K-CWH-1..2, K-CO-1..2, K-CSIG-1, K-CHAIN-1, K-ONL-1)
